messages:
ravi (oncall): apiserver 503s in ap-south1 for ~20m. provisioning backlog growing, lots of etcd wal fsync warnings around 1723455940.
elaine (infra): seeing nvme iowait spike on etcd-leader at 1723455938, `wal sync` p95 ~900ms. grabbing iostat and dmesg.
hugo (platform): controller-manager leader briefly timed out at 1723455951 but re-elected quickly. large burst of pod creates from GPU onboarding at the same time.
ravi (oncall): logs snippet:
```
2024-03-18T03:45:38Z etcdserver: wal sync took 0.92s
2024-03-18T03:45:39Z apiserver: response 503 POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods
2024-03-18T03:45:40Z provisioner: attach queued instance-gpu-23
```
elaine (infra): immediate mitigation: canary change to provisioner config in ap-south1: max_concurrent_attaches 70 -> 20, applying now. also temp scale apiserver 3->6 to spread fd pressure.
hugo (platform): adding 200ms jitter and batching window of 8s to onboarding controller as a quick patch. schedule staging repro tomorrow.
elaine (infra): initial telemetry: after throttle + scale, apiserver 503s down ~60% and wal p95 down to ~240ms. nvme queue depth reduced.
ops-bot: incident INC-2024-1032 created and assigned to eng-sre.
ravi (oncall): next steps: staging synthetic burst, fio on wal disk, consider dedicated io-optimized disk for etcd WAL, and postmortem with cost calc for extra apiserver replicas. leaving watch.
